summary: Pappas campaign site states he reaffirmed Israel's right to exist, supported bipartisan security assistance for Israel, voted for $9B humanitarian aid to Gaza, and calls for ceasefire with hostage return and Hamas destruction.
quote: Chris reaffirmed America's ironclad commitment to protecting Israel's right to exist. He has supported bipartisan security assistance for Israel to defend itself and has voted for more than $9 billion in life-saving humanitarian aid to Gaza.

summary: Concord Monitor reports Pappas sent a letter to constituents two days after the NH primary responding to concerns about humanitarian aid for Gaza, which a constituent criticizes as contradictory.
quote: Two days after the New Hampshire primary, I received a letter from Rep. Chris Pappas responding to concerns about humanitarian aid for Gaza.

summary: Pappas joined 92 House Democrats demanding Secretary Rubio investigate the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation amid a worsening starvation crisis in Gaza.
quote: Congressman Chris Pappas (NH-01) joined 92 House Democrats to demand Secretary of State Marco Rubio open an investigation into the ownership structure and operation of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation (GHF)

summary: Pappas joined a House statement addressing the phrase 'From the River to the Sea' and the ongoing Hamas-Israel War, indicating his position on the slogan's meaning.
quote: On Tuesday, November 7, Congressman Chris Pappas (NH-01) joined a statement on the phrase "from the river to the sea" and the ongoing Hamas-Israel War.

summary: Activist site records that Pappas voted yea on H.R. 6090 (Antisemitism Awareness Act) in May 2024 and voted for supplemental military aid packages including Iron Dome systems for Israel.
quote: In May 2024, Pappas voted yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act

summary: Pappas stated he has 'never wavered' in support of Israel, urges a ceasefire ensuring hostage return, expresses horror at famine in Gaza, and supports new airdrops and humanitarian corridors.
quote: I have never wavered in my support for our steadfast democratic ally... I am horrified by reports of famine and widespread starvation in Gaza. Safe zones must be expanded to ensure adequate aid deliveries can be made

summary: Received $763,737 from AIPAC, UDP & allied pro-Israel PACs; also took an AIPAC-funded trip to Israel.
quote: $763,737 in backing from AIPAC, UDP & allied PACs…$678K via AIPAC PAC ($648K in earmarked donations from AIPAC's donors that it passed on, $30K from the PAC itself) + $85.4K from other PACs…AIPAC-funded trip to Israel

summary: Voted 'present' (abstained) on the Massie amendment to end all U.S. aid to Israel, avoiding a direct yes/no vote.
quote: her colleague Rep. Chris Pappas tried to sidestep the sticky politics of supporting Israel by voting "present."

summary: Voted NO on the Protect Economic and Academic Freedom Act (anti-BDS bill), a reversal from his 2019 pro-Israel BDS vote.
quote: when legislation denying federal funds to universities that discriminate against Israel came to the floor Thursday, Pappas voted no.
